question: For a live meme-token trading model that is losing on high-probability, high PredReturn, high volume_30s, high price_volatility entries that appear to be late-pump or overheated fake runners, what researched methods can improve live profitability without increasing position size? Focus on candidate-level meta-labeling, triple-barrier/path labels, volatility/price-extension/slippage-risk features, abstention/selective classification, and robust time-series validation. The experiment must preserve a strong primary model and use a second-stage veto or conditional entry gate rather than global threshold lowering.
